title: Chrome trim and miscellaneous customer follow-ups
summary: This topic is dominated by brief, context-poor follow-up statements, with the only clear opinion describing a missing requested chrome grille feature.

negative.summary: The clear negative feedback is about an ordered chrome grille not being delivered as requested.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments are too incomplete or varied to determine sentiment, covering follow-up comments about chrome side trim, VR functionality, operating cost savings, hands-free use, and the AUTO option.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are incomplete follow-up statements without enough context to determine sentiment.
The undetermined examples mix unrelated subjects rather than a single coherent issue.
With only one clearly sentiment-labeled example, concrete theme-level conclusions are limited.
